multichip_capacity_plan.reserve_rationale: Native replicated residual is 2GiB per input/output. Public prefill can hold input + chunk outputs + concatenated output (6GiB peak), plus 2GiB for trace, chunk working sets, small constants, allocator overhead and other temporary buffers. Hidden-sharded candidate needs less but does not determine this conservative plan.
multichip_capacity_plan.reservation_limit: Conservative reserved bytes plus one executing native full-attention decoder; direct three-decoder composition is tested separately. No full-model execution claimed.
multichip_capacity_plan.weight_accounting: 576 bytes per BFP4 tile; shared prefill gate/up remain separate. Decode packed gate/up4096x6144 uses14,155,776 bytes/device; down3072x4096 uses7,077,888. Packed decode replaces the two separate decode copies, so total projection bytes stay1,744,175,104. QKVG4096x2560 BFP8 decode uses11,141,120. Eight DRAM banks; gate/up3 readers, down2, QKVG1, no extra width padding.
